fields.name: Chad: Cholera Outbreak - Jul 2025
fields.description:
The cholera outbreak continues to spread, reaching Sila
province after Ouaddaï, where Abdi health district reported
four cases, including one death, last week. In Ouaddaï,
three health districts are affected, with Farchana and
Amléyouna recently reporting additional cases. Since 13
July, Ouaddaï has recorded 1,016 cases and 68 deaths as
of 24 August 2025. State authorities and health partners
are awaiting 1 million cholera vaccine doses from WHO to
launch vaccination campaigns. ([OCHA, 26 Aug 2025](https://reliefweb.int/node/4172349))
